recentItems.title: Trump Envoys Nervous About Visiting Ukraine, 'Plead' Putin? Shock War Demand As They Rush To Kyiv
recentItems.description:
US President Donald Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are heading to Ukraine after holding talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. The discussions come as Washington pushes for progress toward ending the Russia-Ukraine war. The US delegation is expected to hold further meetings in Ukraine, with the outcome of the diplomatic effort being closely watched amid continued fighting and uncertainty over a possible peace deal.

recentItems.title: Nepal Floods: Death Toll Hits 1,344, Nearly 5,000 Missing | Desperate Search For Survivors Continues
recentItems.description:
Nepal is witnessing a devastating flood crisis as the death toll rises to 1,344, with nearly 5,000 people still missing. Rescue teams continue their desperate search for survivors, 11 days after catastrophic flash floods swept through large parts of the country.  Watch the latest updates on the Nepal flood horror and the ongoing rescue operations.
